name: linux-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of Linux, kept locally: Fedora (Quick Docs, release notes, DNF5, RPM), the Linux man-pages (system calls, C library, file formats), systemd, util-linux, the kernel administration guide, GNOME (developer documentation, GTK 4, GLib, GJS), Wayland and its protocols, PipeWire, Flatpak and the SELinux Notebook. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look it up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of Linux: Fedora, dnf, rpm, man-pages (system calls, libc, file formats), systemd units and commands, util-linux (mount, lsblk...), the kernel admin guide (sysctl, cgroups), GNOME, GTK, GLib, GJS, Wayland protocols, PipeWire, Flatpak, SELinux. Returns 10 section ids at most.
